MINI MINUTES: This cause came on a regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner: Sue M. Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/P. Dias, CSR: Patricia Dowling.
Petitioners, Jaimee Marpesia Amanda Whitedove Sweet present with counsel, Yasmine Mehmet. Petitioner was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the decree changing the petitioner's name to Jaimee Marpesia Amanda Whitedove-Sweet. Decree signed in open court.
